frame: Unreal convention: X forward (towards the bow), Y starboard, Z up; metres; the origin is the bridge floor point under the Captain's chair (Unreal: cm, same axes); yaw in degrees turns +X towards +Y; the hull mesh SM_SHIP_ASTRA_Aquila is placed at world (-172, 0, -62): hull frame = world + (172, 0, 62)

decks.name: Command
decks.programme: Bridge, Captain's quarters, ready room, command corridors

decks.name: CIC & Communications
decks.programme: CIC (combat information centre), briefing room, department offices, communications

decks.name: Crew Services
decks.programme: Mess Hall, galley, lounge, observation deck

decks.name: Science & Transport
decks.programme: science labs, Transporter Room (six pads), sensor archive

decks.name: Engineering & Power
decks.programme: Main Engineering, reactor, power control, radiators

decks.name: Marines & Armory
decks.programme: Armory, Marine Barracks, firing range, assault-shuttle bay (two Kestrel shuttles)

decks.name: Flight
decks.programme: Flight Deck: launch tubes, bays, aircraft workshop, control booth

decks.name: Keel
decks.programme: keel: tanks, reaction mass, maintenance crawlways

compartments.name: Bridge lift housing
compartments.note: the housing behind the port corridor's end: since NAVE-3 its first 1.8 m (x -22.8 .. -21.0) are the vestibule of the two command turbolifts, whose shafts (x -25.8 .. -22.8) stand in the rest of it (ship_vertical.BRIDGE_SHAFTS); its walls, floor, roof and the shafts' tubes are the mesh SM_SHIP_LiftHousingBridge (ship_deck1.py); the corridor's end cap, the old lift's leaves and sign and the old floor under the shafts are removed by build_ship_interior.py

compartments.name: Crew Berthing
compartments.note: it stands on the Deck 4 plane (z -46, like the Mess), and its signage says so (DECK 4 · SECTION C): the Deck 3 plane (z -42) is under the hull's inner skin here

compartments.name: Main Engineering
compartments.note: a 14 m tall hall: its volume also occupies the Deck 4-6 planes at x -372..-330, |y| < 15 (keep-out for those decks)

compartments.name: Flight Deck
compartments.note: floor z -72.8 (the launch tubes open into the bow mouths); the volume 20 m tall crosses the planes of Decks 6-11 at x 60..218, |y| < 29

compartments.name: Ready Room
compartments.note: the Captain's ready room: the block between the two corridors of Deck 1 (docs/BIBBIA.md §6); its door is cut in the port corridor's inner wall, in the module SM_SHIP_BridgeCorridorDoor that replaces the bridge builder's window module there

compartments.name: Main Engineering lobby
compartments.note: the corridor's end and the room's door meet here: the passage's last bay, finished with the room's deck

compartments.name: Flight Deck lobby
compartments.note: the corridor's end and the room's door meet here: the passage's last bay, finished with the room's deck
